claims.citation: New York Herald, 15 May 1866, p. 5, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Tarifa (Br), Langlands, Liverpool May 1 via
Queenstown 2d, with mdse and 572 passengers to E Cunard.
13th inst, at 2:30 PM, lat 40 50, lon 68 17, passed an Inman
and a National Steamship Co's steamer, bound E.
